payload.text: ST0093/06 stays WIP until devbin's next release (issues 0335, 0338, 0339) is vendored into Intent. Then dc builds (c) a build: block declaring the pair, its handlers calling cache get/put; (d) gate rust's target at DEVBIN_GATE_CACHE; (e) tests/run_tests.sh onto devbin's lanes runner, with daemon and socket tests tagged serial. One proof run for the batch, then land. (a) and (b) landed at 6375023ea; the macos leg first runs at the next cut.
